purpose: Prospective acceptance plan and blank results for an actual target-device release candidate; no device tests claimed.

target.guest_memory: compact low 1 GiB + top 1 MiB windows

reference_evidence.scope: Linux no-JIT/strict memory menus, first mission/tutorial and save creation.
Linux compact memory accepted existing save and transformed Bumblebee; savegame unchanged.
Linux compact memory one adjacent-tile move after ordinary same-destination taps 18.983 s apart; savegame unchanged.
Independent frame/log review, bounded runs and remaining limits.
30 framed mission command streams/803 commands; not a proven count of campaign levels or complete opcode semantics.
Original 10/30 ms one-shot timer and pre-presentation HUD audit; sparse existing Linux captures around 22.0–22.3 render calls/s, not XR or frame-pacing evidence.

performance_targets.kind: Proposed project tolerances, not measured results or platform guarantees.
performance_targets.loading_and_transition_intervals: Report separately with explicit labels; do not silently exclude slow gameplay.
measurement_constraints: Existing host FPS counter increments before actual presentation succeeds and cannot alone pass D03.
Use successful presentation/completion timestamps, correlate guest frame IDs and animation/content progress, and record attempted presents separately.
Do not count repeated old buffers at 60 Hz as 60 new game frames.
Native 10 ms/30 ms timer re-arm investigation is a timing constraint; selected branch/render relation remains unresolved and it is not an XR cap measurement.
Do not accelerate timers solely to reach the FPS target; preserve original simulation and scripted timing.
Record instrumentation/screen-recording overhead; missing measurements or timing reference leave gates unverified.
performance_targets.existing_sparse_linux_sample_scope: Approximately 22.0–22.3 render calls/s before SDL swap from 60-frame-spaced captures; no actual-device or individual-frame timing inference.

campaign_coverage.scope: Full normal campaign at the recorded difficulty, including final end screen.

gates.title: Install and launch
procedure: Install the identified IPA using Sideloadly on iPhone XR/iOS 17.5.
Cold-launch three times; collect game screen and CPU/memory-mode diagnostics.
pass_criteria: Installation and three launches succeed with intended interpreter and compact memory.
Ordinary user signing setup needs no extra JIT activation.

gates.title: Input and rendering
procedure: Exercise menus and screen-edge buttons, unit/tile selection and same-destination confirmation.
Pan/zoom camera; inspect supported orientation changes, dialogue, tutorial and 3D-model screens.
pass_criteria: Visible targets match touch locations and remain reachable.
No missing resources, clipped text, broken overlays or stuck input.

gates.title: Sustained 60 FPS
procedure: Record actual successful presentation timestamps in an animated mission for at least 20 uninterrupted minutes, including busy AI/combat/camera activity.
Repeat after the phone is warm; record guest-present attempts and content/animation progress separately.
pass_criteria: Meets proposed presentation and pacing thresholds in performance_targets.
Old-buffer repetition and pre-presentation HUD counts are not counted as new game frames.

gates.title: Correct game time
procedure: Measure foreground wall and guest monotonic time for at least 10 minutes.
Compare selected movement/animation/scripted sequences with an established original-game reference or independently justified timing model.
Include pause/resume and record timer due/fire/re-arm behavior.
pass_criteria: Clock drift meets proposed tolerance.
Animation and scripted timing retain documented reference behavior without extra turns or catch-up bursts.
Missing timing reference leaves this gate unverified.

gates.title: Complete normal campaign
procedure: Start a new normal campaign at a recorded difficulty.
Record every visible mission start, objectives, victory/transition and final campaign/end screen.
Map recovered stream IDs where identified; account for shared/optional/unmapped resources separately.
pass_criteria: Selected normal campaign completes through original controls without forced progression or skipped unresolved failures.
30 recovered streams are not represented as 30 proven campaign levels.
Unvisited optional modes and branches remain explicitly uncovered.

gates.title: Mechanics and branches
procedure: Exercise player/enemy turns, close/ranged combat, retaliation, damage/death, transform, upgrade, repair and capture/energy.
Cover terrain/pathfinding, later units, tutorial/dialogue, victory and defeat/retry.
pass_criteria: Exercised mechanics match expected original-game behavior.
AI turns and scripted objectives complete.
List mechanics and branches not exercised.

gates.title: Changed-state save and cold reload
procedure: Change unit/mission state through movement/transformation and combat/capture or mission progression.
Use normal save, exit, terminate and cold-launch; repeat in a later mission.
pass_criteria: New changed state and progress survive cold reload without corruption or rollback.
Reloading only the preexisting unchanged save does not pass.
required_evidence: visible state before exit and after reload

gates.title: Audio
procedure: Enable audible output and exercise menus, battle effects, dialogue where present, transitions and volume/mute controls.
Repeat after resume.
pass_criteria: Expected audio is audible, synchronized and stable.
No persistent missing channels, distortion or resume-related audio loss.

gates.title: Lifecycle and endurance
procedure: Background/foreground and lock/unlock during mission, dialogue and safe save boundary.
Exercise an interruption, repeated cold launches and a long campaign session; record memory/thermal behavior and pacing.
pass_criteria: No stuck input/audio, lost progress, allocation failure or crash.
Foreground resumes correctly and warm performance meets D03.

release_decision.rule: All mandatory gates need recorded passes on the same identified release candidate. Rerun affected gates after fixes. Scope confidence to tested device, artifact, route and difficulty; preserve untested branches rather than promise absence of every bug.
